summary: Focused re-test of admin deep-link auth race fix. Both scenarios PASS: (1) Hard/direct load of /admin route as admin — AuthContext restores token, then load() fires when user.role==='admin', /api/admin/overview|projects|polls|reports all return 200, all live-activity stat cards (stat-now, stat-users-5m, stat-1h, stat-24h) and community totals render; no infinite spinner and ZERO 401s. (2) In-app navigation Profile → Admin Dashboard — dashboard loads immediately with stats visible and all admin endpoints returning 200. Fix verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin dashboard load() useCallback deps are empty ([]); the guarded useEffect `if (user?.role === 'admin') load()` correctly re-runs when user resolves, so the fix is effective. Consider adding `user` to load's deps too for consistency, though not required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin deep-link race fix verified. Hard-loading /admin now waits for user resolve before firing apiFetch, resulting in 200s and populated stat cards (stat-now, stat-users-5m, stat-1h, stat-24h). In-app nav also unaffected.
rca_of_issue: Previously load() fired on mount before AuthContext restored token from AsyncStorage → apiFetch sent no Bearer → 401 → overview stayed null → infinite ActivityIndicator. Fix guards load() invocation on user?.role==='admin' in useEffect and re-runs when user resolves. Verified via direct navigation to /admin URL and observing sequential 200s on /api/auth/me → /api/admin/*.
